properties.name: shelf_shoaling
properties.why: 100 m across the shoaling band, ring-wide (v1.5 rule).

properties.name: inland_floodplain
properties.why: 100 m on land 0..6 m: the Sandy HWM ceiling on v3 is 5.79 m (185 marks). v1.5 used 9 m; on 15,000 km2 of coastal plain the top 3 m buy nothing but cells. 2026-08-25: zmax 6 -> 5 tried as lever L1; 2026-08-26 RESTORED to 6 (user) - the two levers together saved only 1.3% of faces, not worth the resolution.

properties.name: low_water
properties.why: 50 m over every back-bay, estuary and tidal marsh the domain exists to COMPUTE, and the land below 3 m that flooded. v1.5's bay_water, ring-wide. 2026-08-25: zmax 3 -> 2 tried as lever L2; 2026-08-26 RESTORED to 3 (user) - the two levers together saved only 1.3% of faces; the count driver is the 25 m surf_dune band, not this.

properties.name: cape_may_canal
